verdict.rationale: Gladia is a speech-to-text and audio-intelligence API, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The evidence shows no first-party automation objects to version. Its Zapier, Make and n8n integrations are third-party host platforms, and its model selection is a different feature, so neither makes this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
